Project-R is a strategic independent commercial project under the SSCCS
initiative, already in its early build phase with a portential manufacturing partner.

Existing context infrastructure -- vector stores, graph knowledge bases, MCP
servers -- targets developers and technical professionals. While dozens of new
solutions launch every week, almost all are software layers designed for
engineers. Project-R aims for anyone who sits at a computer, across all ages,
and non-human actors such as autonomous agents and robots.

A large language model is stateless, essentially a brain with amnesia. Every
interaction begins from zero, and the context that makes it useful -- prompts,
documents, history -- lives on cloud infrastructure. As governments pour
billions into sovereign models, this contextual surface is often overlooked.
Project-R was born from this observation.
